component.name: QuickShare Studio
component.summary: Share files, clipboard and PDFs between your devices

description.p: QuickShare Studio sends files and clipboard text or images between Linux, Windows and Android devices over the same Wi-Fi or across the internet, end-to-end encrypted, after pairing with a 6-digit code or a QR code. It also turns screenshots into print-ready PDFs and merges, splits, compresses and OCRs PDFs.
